sources.citation: Studia Iranica 23 (1994), fasc. 1 and 2, tables of contents (Peeters Online Journals).
sources.note: Checked only to locate Elfenbein 1994: not in either fascicle (so the Glottolog journal attribution is wrong; the article is in StII 19).

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Consonant and vowel tables only; no mention of stress, accent or tone. Used for its bibliography (corrects the Elfenbein venue and the Birmani & Ahmed venue/DOI).

sources.citation: Morgenstierne, Georg. 1935 [Glottolog dates 1934]. A Note on the Khetrani Dialect of Lahnda. Acta Orientalia XIII: 173-175.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Three-page wordlist (c. 90 items + numerals, 5 sentences) collected at Harnai 1929; some forms carry Morgenstierne's raised-tick stress mark (e.g. 'thamba 'pillar', 'kha. 'chin') but there is no statement of where the accent falls; he remarks only that he 'was unable to detect any important variations from ordinary Lhd.'

sources.citation: Grierson, George A. 1919. Linguistic Survey of India, Vol. VIII Part 1: Sindhi and Lahnda. Calcutta. pp. 372ff 'Khetrani or Khetranki, and Jafiri'.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Introductory remarks (Dardic-looking traits: de-aspiration, final aspiration, cerebralisation, vigesimal counting) plus Dames's vocabulary and sentences; nothing on stress or accent.

sources.citation: Birmani, Ali H. & Fasih Ahmed. 2017. Language of the Khetrans of Barkhan of Pakistani Balochistan: A preliminary description. Lingua 191-192: 3-21.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: publisher DOI, paywalled; library e-access not checked
sources.note: Modern first-hand 'preliminary description' with a phoneme inventory (source of Wikipedia's tables); may include a suprasegmental note and would supersede/confirm Elfenbein. Closed access, no OA copy per Unpaywall.

sources.citation: Any MPhil/PhD thesis by Ali H. Birmani on Khetrani (Pakistani university, c. 2015-2018) underlying the Lingua article.

sources.citation: Elfenbein, Josef. 1994. A note on the Khetrāni phonology. Studien zur Indologie und Iranistik 19: 71-82.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: online with a university library login; also in print at Harvard (Widener Library, call number DS251.S78)
sources.note: The only dedicated phonological description of Khetrani (12 pp., by the leading Balochi/Indo-Iranian fieldworker); Glottolog listed by Glottolog as a phonology. Most likely to contain an explicit accent statement. Glottolog mislabels the journal as Studia Iranica; request StII 19 from a library.
